texts.zh: 显然，斯克兰德陷入了与我们自己的一位指挥官[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的肢体冲突。问题与舰队司令的个人荣誉感有关。简而言之，斯克兰德觉得自己受到了侮辱，他表示，除非我们解除[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的职务，否则他将立即离开我们。
texts.en: Apparently Skrand got into a physical altercation with [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName], one of our own commanders. The issue has to do with the Admiral's deep sense of personal honor. In short, Skrand feels insulted, and has stated he will leave our service immediately unless we relieve [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName] of their duties.

tooltips.zh: 如果在这个问题上选择斯克兰德，我们可能会面临更多的反弹。
tooltips.en: We might face more backlash if we settle with Skrand on this issue.

texts.zh:
虽然我们的基层军官和指挥官正在与斯克兰德密切合作，但他们也不是完全言听计从。双方所习惯的指挥结构不同，带来了一些不必要的紧张局面。因此我们亟需一场联合军事演练。

该演练可能会降低我们指挥舰队的能力，但不能准备好军队的话可能会导致极其严重的后果。
texts.en:
Our officers and commanders are working closely with Skrand, but they are not always in accord with him. Their preferred command structures differ, causing unnecessary tension. This has precipitated a need for joint military training.

The work may limit our ability to command our fleets, but failing to properly prepare the troops could have dire consequences.

tooltips.zh: 该项目可能花费非常高昂，且一旦开始我们便无法停止。
tooltips.en: This project might be costly, and we will be unable to cancel it once we begin.

label.zh: 这种军事演习有什么意义么。

texts.zh: 指挥整合计划关注与缓解海军指挥层的内斗，特别是斯克兰德和我们的人之间的矛盾。寻找到紧张局面的根源可以改善我们指挥流程的效率。
texts.en: The command integration project focuses on easing infighting within the admiralty, especially between Skrand and our own personnel. Addressing the root causes of the tension could improve the efficacy of our command processes.

texts.zh: 双方都取得了显著进展，我们认为联合演训项目取得了巨大成功。我们从斯克兰德那里学到了很多关于近距离太空作战的知识，同时他和他的军官们也熟悉了我们的后勤系统。一种新的乐观主义和同志情谊已经在军队中扎根下来。
texts.en: With exceptional progress on both sides, we consider the joint training program a great success. We learned much from Skrand about close-quarters space combat, while bringing him and his officers up to speed on our logistics practices. A new sense of optimism and camaraderie has taken root.

texts.zh:
主要问题在于我们使用舰载机的战术截然不同。斯克兰德部署了多个大型攻击机小组来打破敌人的指挥链。他们在母舰的明确目标下联合行动。

我们的方法则更灵活，让他们承担一些态势感知型的任务，并去执行高危险高回报的行动，但我们缺乏斯克兰德和他的军官所拥有的大局观。目前，我们还在努力寻找可以一起建立的共同基础。
texts.en:
The main problem lies in how differently we employ strike-craft tactics. Skrand deploys multiple large strike-craft teams to break the enemy's chain of command. They operate united by clear objectives from their mother ship.

Our approach is more flexible with roles dictated by situational awareness and the use of potentially high-risk, high-reward actions, but we lack the cohesion seen in Skrand and his officers. For now, we still strive to find a common ground to build on.

texts.zh:
模拟战斗表明，斯克兰德的集中火力战术在最初阶段非常奏效，但很快会被反制战术所克制。即便如此，他战果也还是比起我们的的表现好得多。

同时实施这两种战术会导致混乱。幸运的是，从这些失败中产生了可能想法，这将缓解潜在的问题。
texts.en:
Simulation battles have shown Skrand's concentrated tactics are very effective at first, but quickly fail against counter strategies. Even so, the results were superior to those we could expect ourselves.

Implementing parts of both tactics in parallel resulted in chaos. Fortunately, from these failures emerged promising ideas that should alleviate the underlying problems.
